domains.records.txt.explanation: Create a TXT record proving you own {hostname}.
domains.records.cname.explanation: Create a CNAME record routing {hostname} to our edge.
domains.records.apex.explanation: Create A records routing {hostname} to our anycast addresses. CNAME is not allowed at the apex; if your provider supports ALIAS/ANAME records, one record to the CNAME target also works.
domains.records.generic.explanation: Create this record at your DNS provider.
domains.guides.generic.title: Set up DNS records at your provider
domains.guides.generic.step_1: Open your DNS provider's zone editor for {hostname}.
domains.guides.generic.step_2: Add the TXT record exactly as shown.
domains.guides.generic.step_3: Add the routing records exactly as shown.
domains.guides.generic.step_4: Save and come back here; verification runs automatically and can take a few minutes to hours to propagate.
domains.guides.cloudflare.title: Set up DNS records in Cloudflare
domains.guides.cloudflare.step_1: Open Cloudflare and select the zone for {hostname}.
domains.guides.cloudflare.step_2: Under DNS → Records, add a TXT record with the values shown. Leave proxy (orange cloud) off for the challenge record.
domains.guides.cloudflare.step_3: Add the routing record shown. For a CNAME you may keep proxying off while verification runs.
domains.guides.cloudflare.step_4: Wait a few minutes and return; verification runs automatically.
domains.guides.route53.title: Set up DNS records in Route 53
domains.guides.route53.step_1: Open the Route 53 hosted zone for {hostname}.
domains.guides.route53.step_2: Create a record with type TXT and the values shown.
domains.guides.route53.step_3: Create the routing record shown. At the apex, prefer an A record with the anycast IPs, or an ALIAS record if offered.
domains.guides.route53.step_4: Wait a few minutes and return; verification runs automatically.
domains.guides.godaddy.title: Set up DNS records at GoDaddy
domains.guides.godaddy.step_1: Sign in to GoDaddy and open DNS management for {hostname}.
domains.guides.godaddy.step_2: Add the TXT record with the values shown.
domains.guides.godaddy.step_4: Wait a few minutes and return; verification runs automatically.
domains.guides.namecheap.title: Set up DNS records at Namecheap
domains.guides.namecheap.step_1: Sign in to Namecheap and open Advanced DNS for {hostname}.
domains.guides.namecheap.step_2: Add a TXT record with the values shown (Host: _sanvi-challenge).
domains.guides.namecheap.step_4: Wait a few minutes and return; verification runs automatically.
domains.guides.google_domains.title: Set up DNS records in Google Domains
domains.guides.google_domains.step_1: Open Google Domains and select DNS for {hostname}.
domains.guides.google_domains.step_2: Add the TXT record with the values shown.
domains.guides.google_domains.step_4: Wait a few minutes and return; verification runs automatically.
domains.guides.onamae_jp.title: お名前.com で DNS レコードを設定する
domains.guides.onamae_jp.step_1: お名前.com にログインし、{hostname} の DNS 設定を開きます。
domains.guides.onamae_jp.step_2: 表示どおりに TXT レコードを追加します。
domains.guides.onamae_jp.step_3: 表示どおりにルーティング用レコードを追加します。
domains.guides.onamae_jp.step_4: 数分待ってから確認してください。検証は自動で実行されます。
domains.guides.value_domain.title: バリュードメインで DNS レコードを設定する
domains.guides.value_domain.step_1: バリュードメインにログインし、{hostname} の DNS 設定を開きます。
domains.guides.value_domain.step_2: 表示どおりに TXT レコードを追加します。
domains.guides.value_domain.step_3: 表示どおりにルーティング用レコードを追加します。
domains.guides.value_domain.step_4: 数分待ってから確認してください。検証は自動で実行されます。
